items.criterion: A well data enquiry submitted with consent creates exactly one modelling request row carrying every submitted field.
items.judgment: Submit the enquiry once, then read the request back through the engineer queue and compare every field with what was sent.

items.criterion: The stored modelling request records the route the visitor submitted from.
items.judgment: Submit from a case route and confirm the stored row names that route rather than a default.

items.criterion: An identical enquiry submitted twice in immediate succession leaves exactly one modelling request.
items.judgment: Submit the same payload twice without pause and count the rows carrying that address.

items.criterion: An enquiry submitted without consent is rejected and writes no row.
items.judgment: Submit with consent false and confirm both the client error and the unchanged row count.

items.criterion: An anonymous caller is denied every read of the modelling request queue and every change to a request.
items.judgment: Call the queue and a request update with no token and confirm each is denied.

items.criterion: A denied change from an anonymous caller leaves the targeted request row unchanged.
items.judgment: Attempt the change with no token, then read the row as an engineer and compare it with its previous value.

items.criterion: Every one of the ten size variants appears in the specification table of its own product family.
items.judgment: Read each family detail response and confirm each declared variant is a column of that family's size table.

items.criterion: A specification cell whose value has not been measured prints a single dash.
items.judgment: Read the FRS size table and confirm the unmeasured cells carry a dash rather than an empty value or a zero.

items.criterion: Every published case metric carries a provenance naming where the figure came from.
items.judgment: Read every case response and confirm no metric is published with an absent or empty provenance.

items.criterion: A case detail route is addressed by its well number rather than by a generated slug.
items.judgment: Request the case route at the well number and confirm it resolves to that case.

items.criterion: The catalogue and the evidence library resolve each other in both directions.
items.judgment: Open a family detail response and confirm it names the cases that ran it, then open one of those cases and confirm it names the family.

items.criterion: A reader who mistypes an address reaches the product's own not-found page and a not-found response.
items.judgment: Request an address that does not exist and confirm both the product's own page and the not-found status.
